subject: A DRAGON FORGE
body:
A DRAGON FORGE. Oh, she's beautiful. Ye don't need one of the big monsters to keep it lit, mind. Sit a grown Nadder or Gronckle near it and they'll keep a fire forge roaring, and a Night Fury does the lightning one. Slower, aye, but they won't try to eat the blacksmith. Here's how she's put together, brick by brick. @archive:integrated_boogaloo:iaf_dragon_gear @display:integrated_boogaloo:guide/dragon_forge
